name: Octogee Chat Tools
description: Search and browse the workspace chat from the Coach.

mattermostUrl.description: RETIRED — MM reads moved server-side (fleet broker chat endpoints). Accepted so configs written before the relocation still validate; ignored.

siteUrl.description: Public-facing Mattermost URL used to build permalinks, e.g. https://mattermost.octogee.com

patCacheTtlSeconds.description: RETIRED — no PAT lives in the extension anymore. Accepted for pre-relocation configs; ignored.

brokerUrl.description: Base URL of octogee-api/fleet broker. Defaults to FLEET_BROKER_URL, OCTOGEE_API_URL, or in-cluster octogee-api.

tokenPath.description: Path to the projected gateway service-account token.

customersRoot.description: Root directory containing mounted user workspaces.
